verdict.rationale: Medusa Cloud's pricing page lists 'Instant previews on PRs', a first-party non-production preview environment where changes can be tested before reaching production. Nothing documents that these previews use isolated or seeded data separate from production, and there is no dedicated sandbox mode. Missing for 10: documented data isolation of preview environments from production, an explicit sandbox or test-mode environment (e.g. test payments), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
